page.overview:
What is Draught of Peace?

The Draught of Peace was a potion which relieved anxiety and agitation. Its ingredients were powdered moonstone, syrup of hellebore, powdered porcupine quills, and powdered unicorn horn. It should have been a turquoise blue colour when finished, and simmered before being consumed.

Penny Haywood brewed this potion in the 1988–1989 school year with Jacob's sibling.

This was the first potion that Severus Snape assigned to fifth-year students in 1995. A lot of students did poorly, including Seamus Finnigan, Gregory Goyle, Neville Longbottom, and Ron Weasley. However, Professor Snape singled out Harry Potter, giving him alone a zero grade for the day's work by emptying out his cauldron for simply missing out the syrup of hellebore due to misreading the instructions. Despite this, and his potion letting out dark grey smoke at the end, other students did even worse at points: Ron's potion let out green sparks and smelled like rotten eggs, Seamus had to deal with the flames below his cauldron on the verge of turning off, Neville's potion had the consistency of concrete and Goyle's potion was the worst one, as his flask exploded, causing his clothes to catch fire.

Poppy Pomfrey later administered this potion to several fifth-year students suffering from anxiety and panic over the Ordinary Wizarding Levels.
